# Gizmos

> 550+ interactive STEM simulations and virtual labs for K-12 math and science education, featuring hands-on inquiry-based learning through STEM Cases.

Gizmos by ExploreLearning provides research-based, interactive virtual labs and simulations that help students explore real-world scientific concepts through guided inquiry and problem-solving. The platform combines traditional simulations with STEM Cases—structured, case-based learning experiences that connect classroom learning to authentic challenges.
